headline: US Aviation Authorities Issue Nationwide Ground Stop For Flights
seoTitle: US Grounds Flights Due To Technical Issues
metaDescription: US aviation regulators have implemented a nationwide ground stop for departing flights following widespread air traffic control communications issues.
aiSummaryBullets: A nationwide ground stop has been issued for all flights departing from airports across the United States.
Regulators cite a communications disruption affecting air traffic control systems as the primary cause for the suspension.
Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy stated that technical teams are investigating the outage, with authorities confirming no immediate security threats.
aiContextParagraph: On November 13, 2026, aviation regulators in the United States initiated an immediate, nationwide ground stop affecting all departing commercial flights. The decision was prompted by persistent communication difficulties impacting air traffic control facilities across the country. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy confirmed that federal aviation technicians are actively working to identify and resolve the nature of the technical failure. Following reports of the widespread grounding, Homeland Security lead Markwayne Mullin addressed public concern by stating that there is no evidence to suggest that the communication issues stem from an external threat or malicious act. The event has resulted in significant disruption to domestic travel operations, with aviation authorities providing updates as technicians continue their assessment of the infrastructure. Air traffic control remains the primary focus of the ongoing investigation into this rare and large-scale aviation incident.
